name: GitHub Webhook Handlers
description: Reference webhook plugin (SPR-069, TASK-386/387). Declares canonical `webhooks[]` handlers that the aish-webhook-client dispatcher fork/exec's — NO shell is ever involved. Each handler receives the GitHub event payload as JSON on stdin plus WEBHOOK_* env vars, and emits a concise one-line summary on stdout. Covers pull_request (review triage), workflow_run (CI failure alert), and release (publish notice). Filters are AND-combined equality checks over dotted payload paths so a handler only runs on the exact actions it cares about.
author: LightHeart Ventures
